notes: Word list en/zh taken verbatim from the book's appendix 'Words and expressions' (Unit 3 runs from book p62 to p63 / PDF pp68-69).
Bold = 义务教育英语课程标准二级词汇. By measured stroke width, all 13 Unit 3 words are bold.

grandpa/grandma: the book gives both paternal and maternal meanings (祖父；外祖父 / 祖母；外祖母); sister/brother cover older and younger (姐姐；妹妹 / 哥哥；弟弟). For a kids' game you may want to show 爷爷/外公 etc. together.
Picturable nouns for cards: mum, dad, grandpa, grandma, sister, brother, family (plus me). Function words: my, and, this, is, love.
Sentence/dialogue Chinese translations are NOT printed in the book – they are translations for the game.
'page' = printed book page; 'pdf_page' = PDF page index (book +4 for pp.1-61; appendix word list printed 62/63 is PDF 68/69).
